Welcome to the world of Chocolatier!

Generations ago, confectioner Marten Baumeister founded the chocolate company that bears his name, and for over a hundred years, the company has survived family squabbles, hostile competitors, and economic ups and downs.

Today, in the twin shadows of the Great Depression and World War II, the company's factories have been converted for the war effort or lie unused, and the disappearance of her husband Sean has left Alex Tangye Fletcher unavailable to steer the company.

Can you help them?

Chocolatier: Decadence by Design Reforged is a total conversion and engine overhaul of the 2009 classic. Built by reverse-engineering the long-abandoned Playground SDK™ and unlocking the game's XML and Lua data, Reforged modernizes the Baumeister legacy for 2026 and beyond while preserving the original world, artwork, story, and core gameplay.

Experience a dynamic living economy driven by weekly random events and regional and global holidays. Reforged also adds selectable difficulty tiers, expanded dialogue and character interactions, new lore, a revamped Special Order system, the Catalogue encyclopedia, and broader progression changes. Prices, rewards, reputation, and many other variables have been retuned to give veteran Chocolatiers a fresh challenge without replacing the original campaign.

Want to tweak the game? The Playground SDK™ gives loose files priority over packed data, and Reforged exposes the game's XML and Lua scripts in readable form. Open the assets folder with any basic text editor to change dialogue, recipes, prices, characters, or quests—or go further and design new ports, event chains, economies, and your own custom expansions.
The Chocolatier community keeps the series alive. Visit the Wiki for guides and documentation, or join the Discord to share mods, ask questions, and chat.

Your map shows an overview of your chocolate empire, indicating where you are, where you have been, and where you might be going soon.

As you grow your business, you will take control of shops and factories, and there are even rumors of a secret test kitchen where you can invent your own recipes.
Steam rises from operational factories; stalled factories appear red.
As your business expands, shops you own will be marked.
Ports remain locked until you have the proper credentials. You may even discover secret locations that weren't previously visible on the map!
Dots mark available ports. Roll over a port icon for info on cost and length of travel, then click to travel there.

In every port, there are buildings, monuments, parks, and other public spaces full of interesting people.

Buildings you can explore will pulse when you enter a port or roll over them. Click on a building or location to visit - you never know who you might meet! New ports will become available as you complete quests, build your business, and reach higher ranks.

Vendors in markets and farms supply the ingredients you need to manufacture your products. Purchases are transported automatically to the factories where they are needed. Some locations carry exclusive ingredients, while specialty goods are bought directly from the farmers who grow them.

To purchase an ingredient, click its sack and enter the quantity into the calculator. Use the +1, +10, +100, and +1000 buttons to adjust large orders quickly. When you are ready, click "%buy%" to complete your purchase.

Ingredient prices change from week to week, and local events or rumors can temporarily push prices up or down. Seasonality still matters: ingredients can become much more expensive when they are out of season, while higher difficulties make poor prices and failed negotiations more punishing. If you don't like a vendor's prices, haggling may improve them—but an unsuccessful attempt can make the deal worse.

Turn your products into cash at chocolate shops around the world. Different shops buy different kinds of products, and sale prices can shift from week to week with local market events and holiday demand. Vary what you sell, watch for unusually good prices, and consider investing in shops when the opportunity arises.

To sell a product, click its box and enter the quantity into the calculator. Use +1, +10, +100, and +1000 to adjust the amount quickly, then click "%sell%". "%sell_all%" in the calculator sells all of that product; "%sell_all%" in the shop sells every product the shop currently buys.

Owning shops also opens your business network to Special Orders. As time passes, customers may request one or more products in bulk for a fixed payment. You may encounter an offer in person or receive it later by telegram; accepted orders appear in the Quest Log and must be completed before their deadline. Haggling can improve a shop's prices, but a failed negotiation can send them sharply in the other direction.

In your chocolate factories, use the mouse to aim and fire ingredients from the injector into the floating trays.

Fill the trays with ingredients to match the recipe shown in the machinery on the right of the factory screen.

The machine will turn full trays into chocolates as they pass by.

Ingredients that hit a tray snap into the correct slot, but miss 8 times and production will be halted.

Ingredients with colored rings can give you a big production boost. Fill a tray with ingredients of the same color to get an instant bonus.
You have 60 seconds to make as many products as you can. Once configured, the factory will continue making chocolates every week as long as you have enough ingredients on hand.

A wide conveyor belt carries ingredients slowly through your coffee factories. Use the mouse to aim and fire ingredients from the injector onto the conveyor.

Make groups of at least three across or at least three down, and all the matching ingredients touching your groups of three will be carried into the coffee machinery.

The machine produces coffee when it has enough ingredients, and you have 60 seconds to make as many products as possible.
Larger ingredient groups will give you instant product bonuses, so plan your shots carefully. Miss 8 shots and production will be halted.
Once configured, the factory will continue making coffee products every week as long as you have enough ingredients on hand.
In the Secret Test Kitchen, you have total creative freedom to combine your ingredients in new and interesting ways to create recipes never seen before.

Bring a sample of the ingredients you collect to your Secret Test Kitchen, where they will be kept in stock for your experiments. Small gray bottles hold places for ingredients you have yet to collect.

To create a recipe, select a product category from the bulletin board. You can now customize your recipe's complexity by adding or removing ingredient bowls using the (+/-) buttons! Chocolates support 2 to 6 ingredients, while Coffees utilize 3 to 5. Click drawers to place ingredients, and click a full bowl to clear it.

Click "%invent_taste%" to get specific, detailed flavor critiques from Teddy. Pay close attention to his feedback on your pairings! Make adjustments and click "%design_recipe%" when you're ready to move on to the next step.
Once you have created the right combination of ingredients in your Secret Test Kitchen, it's important to market it properly.

Using the large left and right arrows on each of the four image options, select the graphics you want to use for your product. Click on the small color swatch below the images to select a tint you like.

Try hitting the "%randomize%" button to create a random look for your creation.

Don't forget to name your recipe and enter a description for your recipe book, and when you're ready, click "%save_recipe%" to add your creation to your recipe book.

Remember, once you add a recipe to your book you will not be able to edit or delete it, but don't worry, the directors of Baumeister Confections will give you plenty of opportunities to experiment with your own recipes.

People around the world may need help securing ingredients, making products, inventing recipes, delivering goods, or managing relationships. Reforged also adds Special Orders generated through your growing shop network.

The Quest Log tracks active and completed work. Select an entry to review its goals and, when relevant, its payment and deadline. Difficulty can change a quest's requirements or time limit when you accept it; those conditions then remain fixed for that quest.
A green light indicates a goal you have met.
A darkened indicator light indicates a goal you have not yet met.
A blank indicator indicates a reminder without a specific goal.
Your selected quest goal appears in your ledger. The green indicator flashes when you have completed your goals.

The Catalogue is your personal, auto-updating encyclopedia of the chocolate world, brand new to Chocolatier: Decadence by Design Reforged. As you travel the globe, meet new people, and discover rare ingredients, this repository will automatically fill with valuable information to help you manage your growing empire.

The History tab serves as a centralized archive of the Baumeister family's legacy, housing notes on the rich history of Baumeister Confections' past. You can even find letters, journals and memos left behind by Baumeister family members themselves that you pick up through your career!

The Characters tab contains detailed biographies of the people you meet. As you fulfill Special Orders and interact with locals, you will uncover their specific flavor "Likes" and "Dislikes," which is crucial for predicting their requests and maximizing your profits.

Use the Ingredients tab to track the raw materials you have discovered. It records essential data such as the best known prices, the ports where the ingredient is sold, and critical seasonality calendars so you know when to buy low.
The Ports tab provides historical and geographical data for every location you visit. Unlocked entries will give you a better understanding of the local culture and trade economy.

Entries marked with question marks (????) represent people, places, or ingredients you have not yet discovered. Keep exploring the world and expanding your business to uncover all of the Catalogue's secrets!

During your career as Chocolatier, you will collect, discover, and invent many new recipes to expand your product lines. Your Recipe Book organizes them all for you. Browse your recipes by selecting a category along the top, then select a product in the left panel to review it.
If you do not have all the ingredients required to make the chosen recipe, missing ingredients will be marked by a red X.

The Creations category starts empty and fills with recipes you invent in the Secret Test Kitchen. In Reforged, select a saved Creation and choose "Save Creation" to share it to the Community Cookbook. A Community Account is required.
From inside a factory, use the Recipe Book to choose what that factory produces.

A brief history of Baumeister Confections
Over 100 years ago, Hieronymus Baumeister opened a small shop in Sydney, Australia, to peddle his father Marten's chocolate inventions.
A generation later, Baumeister Confections had become a household name worldwide.
As the turn of the century approached, family squabbles nearly destroyed the company.
Sisters Evangeline and Rowena managed to reconcile and return the firm to its former glory.
But by the roaring '20s, the chocolate empire had grown complacent.
Alex Tangye, spirited granddaughter of Evangeline, used secret ingredients and fresh recipes to turn things around.
But now, the one-two punch of the Depression and the Second World War has left the company splintered once again.
Its great chocolate factories, converted or abandoned, sit idle.
And Alex's husband Sean disappeared during a dangerous wartime mission.
As Alex sets off to search for Sean, she has no choice but to trust the fate of the company to an outsider.
